title: Gradient estimates for $p\left(\cdot\right)$-harmonic differential forms
summary: In this paper, we establish gradient bounds for $p(\cdot)$-harmonic differential forms subject to a Coulomb-type gauge condition. For variable exponents satisfying the log-Hölder continuity assumption, we derive higher integrability estimates of Meyers type, ensuring improved regularity beyond the natural energy space. Furthermore, under the stronger assumption of Hölder continuity of the exponent function, we prove that the gradient of solutions exhibits Hölder continuity.
